review.findings: Two new informational DTO-size findings: the moved 9-member startup value and the 10-member inherited in-process request. No new cycles. review.activityRepair: Returning a retained run explicitly reports PersistingResult before completing only the caller activity. Transition rules and original execution state stay unchanged. All185 cases repeat after this production edit.
